title: Ditzy Desselle debuts with soulful meditation on "DIVINE PLAN"
htmlContent: On her debut single, "DIVINE PLAN," rising R&B singer-songwriter Ditzy Desselle crystallizes with an intimacy and transcendence of voice. This is a ripple of life in rich vocals and brutal accuracy. On "DIVINE PLAN," beautiful, smooth R&B textures interplay with introspective storytelling to guide us through a journey of emotion towards acceptance and trust in the timing of life. Desselle's lyrics are light yet potent, striking a delicate balance between openness and empowerment as she surrenders to an external force. https://soundcloud.com/ditzydesselle/divine-plan-ditzy-desselle-7?utm_source=clipboard&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=social_sharing Production is inviting and minimal, allowing her voice to soar and the message to resonate. The positive side of the chorus is that it tells us, with gentle empathy, that everything unfolds as it's meant to be. Desselle's voice has a plainly identifiable authenticity to it, as she sings with you, urging you to feel both the burden and the freedom of not knowing. It's a blend of meditation and melody that takes you there, perfect for quiet moments or long, desert drives at sunset. In "DIVINE PLAN," Ditzy Desselle, a striking new voice, shows no qualms in merging spiritual depth and contemporary soulfulness. Her debut not only demonstrates her artistry, but it also carries a valuable message that surrender is the most transcendent act of all. The "DIVINE PLAN" is more than a musical journey and a welcome reminder that, within the uncertain, there is beauty in the entire picture. Follow Ditzy Desselle on Instagram and Facebook
